# Data symbols migrated from asm/data/cod/*.s into src/cod/*.c.
#
# Each entry is a symbol name (e.g. D_00631BC0) that has been defined
# in a matched .c file with an explicit `.X.0xVMA` section attribute.
# `tools/rewrite_data_named_sections.py` reads this list and skips the
# corresponding block in the asm-side data file to avoid double
# definitions at link time. The linker reassembles the section in
# VMA order via `SORT_BY_NAME(.X.0x*)` (see `tools/postprocess_ld.py`).
#
# Add a symbol here ONLY after:
#   * the C source defines it with the right initial value and section
#     attribute, AND
#   * `make && verify-target` confirms the .rom round-trips.
#
# One symbol per line. `#` for line comments.
